info.name: Interview Prep Coach API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Interview Prep Coach Flask app.
Run the app locally first: flask --app main run

Set the base_url variable to http://localhost:5000

variable.description: Update this after running Request 1 (Create Session)

request.description: Creates a new coaching session with onboarding data. The response will be a redirect (302) to /chat?session_id=N. Copy the session_id from the redirect URL and update the collection variable.
Sends an in-domain message. Response includes: reply (AI coaching text), tokens (prompt/completion/total), and cost_usd. Token counts grow with conversation history — this proves multi-turn.
Tests the domain boundary. The coach should refuse in-character and redirect back to interview prep — NOT with a generic disclaimer.

Returns aggregated usage stats and per-call breakdown for the session. Check that: (1) prompt_tokens grows with each call (multi-turn proof), (2) estimated_cost_usd is non-zero and computed from real token counts.
A second in-domain message. Compare prompt_tokens with Request 2 — it should be LARGER because the full conversation history is included. This is the multi-turn proof.
